presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Stress: long labels and times for every field (four events — the baseline count — with long labels, the later event, a long loss, one alternative, a labelled link and long captions). coordinator decision 2026-09-26 (standing stress cap rule, LAW-0687/0689–0692 precedent; see SESSION_HANDOFF): after trying the fallback layouts (right-hand text column with stacked scenes at 1:1, two-level staging, shared content drawn once), the near-maximum stress text did not fit every ratio at >= 16 px without scaling; the stress lengths are capped to the longest tried values that fit every ratio, every field still strictly longer than the baseline and every count >= the baseline. Measured 2026-09-26: six events of ~72 characters → 1:1 fallback scale k = 0.83 and a lens under 36 % of the short side; five events of ~58 → k = 0.91; this preset fits every ratio at scale 1 with a real lens.
